claims.claim: Body, engine and suspension for all model of Honda, Acura and Toyota cars and SUVs
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a motorcycle/scooter front headlight assembly; no car body/engine/suspension parts are shown.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy
claims.evidence: No brand/part number/label/markings are readable in the witness report; only a headlight lens/housing is described.

claims.claim: No crack, all clips and brackets complete
claims.evidence: Witness says lens looks intact with no obvious cracks visible, but mounting tabs/clips/brackets completeness is not shown/confirmed beyond general mounting points.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: the photo appears to be a motorcycle/scooter headlight, but the seller claims Toyota car parts; wrong fit is likely.
risks.proof: A clear shot of the exact part number/label on the headlight and a photo showing the mounting pattern compared to the buyer’s vehicle/model (or the seller’s vehicle/model listing).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially wrong-fit/low compatibility (sold as-is for parts/fit risk).

risks.risk: Function risk: headlight may not work (bulb/LED, wiring, ballast/driver, reflector condition).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the headlight switched ON (low/high beam if applicable) with working turn-signal/amber section.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not tested / non-working until proven.

risks.risk: Hidden damage: mounting tabs/clips may be broken, or there may be internal moisture/haze not visible from the single angle.
risks.proof: Multiple close-up photos of all mounting tabs/clips/brackets from different angles plus a check for condensation/moisture inside the lens.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly damaged/needs repair due to limited angle coverage.

risks.risk: Condition risk: lens haze, micro-cracks, or reflector degradation may not be obvious in the photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens surface under light (showing haze/scratches) and a reflector close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst cosmetic condition consistent with used parts.

risks.risk: Counterfeit/brand authenticity risk: cannot confirm 'original Toyota' vs generic/aftermarket from the provided view.
risks.proof: Photo of any Toyota logo/engraving, hologram/serial/part number, and packaging/receipt if available.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of any part number/label/markings on the headlight housing or lens (and confirm the brand).
Send a short video showing the headlight ON (and turn-signal/amber section if present).
Send photos of all mounting tabs/clips/brackets from multiple angles to confirm none are broken.
Show the headlight from the back side (wiring connectors/driver/ballast area) to confirm included components and condition.
Confirm the exact motorcycle/scooter make/model compatibility (or, if it’s actually for a Toyota car, send the correct car headlight photo and mounting pattern).
response.reason: The witness confirms only a motorcycle/scooter front headlight assembly, while the seller claims Toyota car parts; without compatibility and working-function proof, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
